questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

7 × 2 + 4 - 6 ÷ 3 = 12
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

Given statement : 7 × 2 + 4 - 6 ÷ 3 = 12

According to the question, after interchanging the signs:

So,

__
 
• Option - (1) : × and -​

Given statement : 7 × 2 + 4 - 6 ÷ 3 = 12

After interchanging:

7 - 2 + 4 × **6 ÷ 3**__ = 12

7 - 2 + __**4 **____**× 2**__ = 12

__**7 + 8**__ - 2 = 12

__**15 - 2**__ = 12

13 ≠ 12 (LHS ≠ RHS)

__
 
• Option - (2) : = and ×

Given statement : 7 × 2 + 4 - 6 ÷ 3 = 12

After interchanging:

7 = 2 + 4 - **6 ÷ 3**__ × 12

7 = 2 + 4 - __**2 × 12**__

7 = __**2 + 4**__ - 24

7 = 6 - 24

7 ≠ -18 (LHS ≠ RHS)

__
 
• Option - (3) : - and +

Given statement : 7 × 2 + 4 - 6 ÷ 3 = 12

After interchanging:

7 × 2 - 4 + **6 ÷ 3**__ = 12

__**7 × 2**__ - 4 + 2 = 12

__**14 + 2**__ - 4 = 12

__**16 - 4**__ = 12

12 = 12 (LHS = RHS)

__
 
• Option - (4) : - and =

Given statement : 7 × 2 + 4 - 6 ÷ 3 = 12

After interchanging:

**7 × 2**__ + 4 = __**6 ÷ 3**__ - 12

__**14 + 4**__ = __**2 - 12**__

18 ≠ -10 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Hence, "Option - (3)" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Five friends A, B, G, R and T are arranged in a row facing north but not necessarily in the same order. B sits at left end of the row. Only two people are sitting between A and G. A sits immediate next to the B and R sits second to the right of B. Who sits between R and G?
questions.solution:
**Given : **Five friends A, B, G, R and T are arranged in a row facing north.

**Explanation :**

1) B sits at left end of the row.

2) A sits immediate next to the B and R sits second to the right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/373736a9ef37244c28c0dac0a6a68fcded7cfc70ad6ef084389fd038064e63e2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5df6570279641641ae35f516eba77c7a16f1f34749e333cd2175f0b5f87b953a.png] 

3) Only two people are sitting between A and G.

After positing G only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b16e8a73aaa1b8e41dcfab6f061cd98228a1e80bdee39063372305f88c6b5ce.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a46365af249432bfc4111500d017d9d10622366278bf6d45eac3f2cd6658b45.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement T sits between R and G.

Hence, **"T"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Latin : Language :: Fencing : ?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Sport.

Sport

Latin is a language and fencing is a sport. So, just as Latin is a type of language, fencing is a type of sport.

Dance

Although fencing is technically not a type of dance, some might argue that it requires grace and timing much like dance does. However, this analogy doesn't hold as strongly as Fencing: Sport.

Art

Fencing can be considered an art due to its form, precision, strategy and expressiveness - all characteristics of an artistic endeavor. However, it's still primarily recognized as a sport.

Weapon

Fencing does use weapons (épée, foil, and sabre), but this comparison is not as fitting since we're looking for a category to which fencing belongs, in the same way Latin is a example of a language.

Music

This comparison doesn't apply well since fencing is not a form of music. It's a physical and tactical endeavor, not an auditory one.

questions.question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

47, 37, 29, 23, 19, ?
questions.solution:
**Logic : Alternate series of reducing even numbers is subtracted subsequently.**

The series is as follows:

47 - 10 = 37

37 - 8 = 29

29 - 6 = 23

23 - 4 = 19

19 - 2 = 17

Hence, **"17"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'CROWNED' is written as 'OWRCEND'. How will 'SERGENT' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter ⇒ Shifted to the fourth position.
 
• Second letter ⇒ Shifted to the third position
 
• Third letter ⇒ Shifted to the first position 
 
• Fourth letter ⇒ Shifted to the second position
 
• Sixth and seventh letter ⇒ Interchanged their positions 
 
• Eighth letter ⇒ No change

So,

 
• 'CROWNED' is written as 'OWRCEND'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e849d011c8f2058fe9c025712ec0f5f1468d161444e9e75aa49f71ea6fe0afb.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'SERGENT' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb59983ab15bae8b1cbd68efef9123f5808201ed3aaede3f2ecd84e911342ea3.png] 

Hence, "**RGESNET**" is the correct answer.
